Excel formula errors (#NAME?) in the statistics section caused the weighted throughput calculation to fail validation.
The run failed during `test_derived_values_and_stats` in `test_outputs.py`. While basic structure and lookup blocks passed, the statistics matrix (rows 46-47, columns H-L) contained `#NAME?` errors instead of the expected numeric values. Specifically, cells like H46 and I47 failed with `AssertionError: statistics mismatches` because the generated formulas likely referenced undefined names or unsupported functions.
